notes: mc GEOGRAPHY 10-K Note 20: revenue is attributed by legal-entity domicile. FY2025 US 3,364.7m of 3,613.4m (93.1%), all foreign 248.7m (6.9%, up from 3.7% in FY2024; Technology Platform in LATAM/Canada/Switzerland, Hong Kong investing); no single foreign country material; long-lived assets not significant and mostly US. Evidence pf_10k_20260217. No Taiwan/China/tariff/export-control supply exposure (a lender, no physical supply chain).

mc RATES FOMC 27-28 Oct 2026 held the target range 3.75%-4.00% (10-2, Cook and Hammack wanted a hike) after a quarter-point HIKE in September, the first in three years; CME FedWatch put a December hike near 83% per press. Chair Warsh, inflation focus. Evidence mc_fomc_20261028 (press excerpt, confirm vs federalreserve.gov). Direction is up, the opposite of a cut path: higher funding cost for the lender, but the Q3 release says average deposit rate was 145 bp below warehouse-facility cost (about 745m annualized interest saving), deposits 51.3bn (+5.8bn in Q3), 90% of average liabilities (pf_rel_20261027_1). 10y 4.98% on 2026-10-29 (pf_fred_dgs10).

mc CONSUMER CREDIT Labor: Sept 2026 unemployment 4.2% (range 4.1-4.3% since March), payrolls only +29,000 vs about 85-90k expected; a weak-hiring signal (mc_bls_sep2026). NY Fed 2026Q2: 4.7% of household debt in some stage of delinquency (one outlet says 4.8%), card early-delinquency transitions about 8.6%, student-loan 90+ day delinquency 10.6% (up from 10.3%); personal-loan delinquency not found in the excerpts, a gap (mc_nyfed_2026q2). SoFi own: personal-loan annualized charge-off 2.26% in Q3 (-34 bp y/y), about 3.4% excluding late-stage delinquent-loan sales, on-balance 90-day delinquency steady y/y (pf_rel_20261027_1).

mc STUDENT LOANS Federal Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP) opened 2026-07-01 as the only income-driven option for new loans; SAVE borrowers being pushed to RAP; involuntary collections on defaulted federal loans paused since Jan 2026, restart date unannounced (mc_ed_rap_20261022; secondary press, confirm at studentaid.gov). Effect on SoFi's student-loan refinance demand and on the 10.6% federal delinquency overhang not quantified: gap. SoFi student loan charge-off 63 bp in Q3 (pf_rel_20261027_1).

mc EXPOSURE Private-credit funding of the Loan Platform Business: Q3 2026 LPB originated 3.8bn for third parties (personal loans 3.6bn), LPB fee revenue 151.2m of 153.4m LPB contribution (pf_rel_20261027_1); 2026-03-26 agreements totalling over 3.6bn: a leading global bank over 1bn (closed), insurance/financial group 600m over 12+ months (closed), a top-five global asset manager up to 2bn over two years (terms agreed) (mc_sofi_lpb_20260326). Press names Blue Owl and Fortress as buyers (secondary, unconfirmed at source). Hypothesis (unsized): a private-credit pullback or yield demand repricing in a rising-rate, weak-hiring setting would cut LPB volume and push loans back onto SoFi's balance sheet; share of fee revenue exposed is LPB 151.2m of 570.6m total fee revenue (about 26%) in Q3.

mc EXPOSURE Bank capital: SoFi is a bank holding company (SoFi Bank N.A.). Agencies re-proposed Basel III endgame on 2026-03-19 (withdrawing the 2023 plan), comment period closed 2026-06-18; agencies estimate lower aggregate CET1 requirements for Category III/IV (about -5.2%) and a standardized approach for smaller banks; final rule not confirmed as of 2026-09-19, expected Q4 2026 with 2027 start per press. SoFi's category and CET1 headroom not checked here: gap (mc_basel_20260320, secondary). Net direction for a small BHC looks neutral to favorable; hypothesis until the SoFi regulatory capital table (release item 9) is read by another lane.

mc EXPOSURE Crypto regulation: SoFi returned to crypto in Q4 2025 (SoFi Crypto, 503k products at Q3 2026) under OCC guidance permitting national banks to offer crypto custody/services; Q3 2026 crypto transaction revenue 161.6m gross vs cost 160.0m, net 1.6m (9M: 417.5m gross, 3.7m net) so it adds almost no profit (pf_rel_20261027_1). SoFiUSD stablecoin opened to members 2026-05-27; SoFi says the GENIUS Act would require migrating SoFiUSD to a separately licensed or regulated entity (secondary: mc_coindesk_20260507, mc_sofiusd_20260527). Market-structure bill (CLARITY) status not found: gap. Exposure is small in earnings, so a bear mechanism only via reputation or compliance cost; hypothesis.

mc NEWS 2026-10-27 Q3 2026 results 8-K: record originations 16.9bn (personal loans 12.6bn, +69% y/y), total deposits 51.3bn, 17.1m members, 23.2m Financial Services products (pf_rel_20261027_1). Results of 2026-10-27 are citable from 2026-10-29, so a 2026-11-02 as_of is fine.

mc NEWS 2026-06-18 8-K item 5.07 (annual meeting vote results), no business content (identity.json filings). No other 8-K since the 10-Q of 2026-08-06 other than the 2026-10-27 earnings 8-K (SEC list as of the prefetch; not re-checked on EDGAR).

mc NEWS 2026-06 Smith v. SoFi Securities LLC and SoFi Technologies: complaint served June 2026 in N.D. Cal. (10-Q 2026-06-30 legal proceedings); content not read in this lane: gap for the legal reviewer (pf_10q_20260806).
